pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with softened, smooth pixel gradients at edges. Spatial area is large and relatively uniform across the visible mid-section, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnecting light-colored pathways forming a network of three- and four-way junction nodes. Pixel thickness of corridors is consistent across the neck but narrows and becomes more frequent towards the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged 1D silhouette visible along the dorsal neck, characterized by low-frequency, low-amplitude rhythmic peaks.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A structural break and indentation in the mane contour is visible at the transition between the upper neck and the shoulder.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Pronounced localized textural disruptions appearing as raised, nodular, or lumpy growths along the upper dorsal ridge and neck base, showing greyish-brown hyper-pigmentation compared to adjacent patches.
